faqs.q: Will callers know they're talking to AI?
faqs.a: The agent can introduce itself as an AI assistant, and we recommend that it does. Most callers care more about a quick, clear answer than about who gives it.

faqs.a: Yes. You decide when it hands over, for example for complaints, urgent jobs or VIP clients, and which number it transfers to.

faqs.q: Do I need a new phone number?
faqs.a: No. We can forward your existing number, or set up a new local number if you prefer.
